  PROBLEM: The `_semantic_errors` archive guard passes when either `item["from"]` or `item["to"]` is in the COMPLETE set.   WHY: `validate_result` returns no error, `missing_plans` (791-797) is satisfied, and `check_diff` accepts the byte-identical rename or the deletion that matches the HEAD blob. `run_apply` then commits and pushes the archive of a PARTIAL plan with GH_PAT, and `test_archived_plan_must_be_classified_complete` (tests/test_plan_autopilot.py:905-917) does not cover this contradictory pair. All reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:_semantic_errors, lines 720-722: `complete = {c["path"] for c in obj["classification"] if c["status"] == "COMPLETE"}` and `if item["from"] not in complete and item["to"] not in complete:` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The COMPLETE-only archive check passes when either the source `docs/plans/<name>.md` or the target `docs/completed/<name>.md` is COMPLETE; it never looks at the status the source plan actually received. The repository already has a same-name pair: `docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` and its twin under `docs/completed/`.
  WHY: For classification=[{docs/plans/x.md, PARTIAL}, {docs/completed/x.md, COMPLETE}] with archived=[docs/plans/x.md → docs/completed/x.md], `validate_result` returns no errors, `missing_plans` (line 791) is satisfied, and `check_diff` accepts the move. `run_apply` then commits and pushes with GH_PAT, and `test_archived_plan_must_be_classified_complete` never covers this pair. Minimal fix: build `status = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}`, fail when `status.get(item["from"]) != "COMPLETE"`, fall back to `status.get(item["to"])` only when `item["from"]` has no entry, and add a test for the pair.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer did not re-raise the step 4a git-history baseline gap: earlier rounds deferred it (fetch-depth 1, no .git in the container), and judge decisions (entries 6 and 10) accepted it as a NIT.
- HARDENING (README.md, "#### Variables" table, next to the PLAN_AUTOPILOT_ENABLED and PLAN_AUTOPILOT_MAINTENANCE_PR_STALE_HOURS rows) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The repo variable PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL was added to the `plan_autopilot` job env (.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, job env block). Its default (empty means openai/gpt-6-sol, see scripts/plan_autopilot.py line 1677) is documented only in agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md.
  WHY: Minimal fix: add one README row for `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL` (No | empty (`openai/gpt-6-sol`) | orchestrate_poll (`plan_autopilot` job) | Codex fallback model for the PLAN_AUDIT role); estimated lines changed: 1.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:720-723 (inside _semantic_errors) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The COMPLETE archive guard accepts an archive when either `item["from"]` or `item["to"]` is in the COMPLETE-path set, so a model can list the live plan as PARTIAL and the same-name completed file as COMPLETE, then archive the live plan.
  WHY: The check evaluates `("docs/plans/x.md" not in complete) and ("docs/completed/x.md" not in complete)`, which is False, so no error is appended. That violates step 7 of the prompt at line 59 ("only plans classified COMPLETE ... move to docs/completed/"), and `test_archived_plan_must_be_classified_complete` does not cover the pair. Minimal fix: `own = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}`, require `own.get(item["from"]) == "COMPLETE"`, and add a regression test.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:717-723 (`_semantic_errors` archive guard), interacting with `check_diff`'s byte-identical archive branch (archive_deleted + completed_head_blobs) and `missing_plans` (791-797) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "only a plan classified COMPLETE is archived" guard can be bypassed through the `docs/completed/` alias. It passes when EITHER `item["from"]` OR `item["to"]` is COMPLETE, and classification explicitly accepts `docs/completed/` paths (line 710).
  WHY: A PARTIAL plan passes `validate_result`, and `check_diff` consults only `result["archived"]`, `refreshed`, and blob identity, never classification status. `run_apply` then pushes the move with GH_PAT. `test_archived_plan_must_be_classified_complete` (tests/test_plan_autopilot.py:905-917) covers only the happy cases. Minimal fix: `own = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}`, fail when `own.get(item["from"], "COMPLETE" if item["to"] in complete else None) != "COMPLETE"`, and add a regression test.
